system.description:
You move with a speed no mortal can match, already taking your next stroke while others are still recovering from the last.

By expending a Blood Trait, in addition to the benefits of Alacrity, you gain one additional physical action that takes place after all other actions in the turn are completed. This extra action may be used only for physical feats, never Mental or Social Disciplines, whose effects transpire too quickly to be processed at such speed. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, though each action may be retested by its own Ability, and a surprised character cannot use Celerity on the first challenge. The effect lasts one turn.
